test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Six letters D, H, K, L, R and Y are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure, Which is the letter on the face opposite to the face containing H? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f51816e23d555278e03e5645cb23b2defbc3c967d55c83da379245531d4d210.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As K is common on both the dice, it is clear that R, H, L, and D are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. Y will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0eeb67550836b2dd6583811d73e50cc95a3cfa206a50b7335fdf330a485a6976.png] 

Opposite pairs:

R → L

H → D

K → Y

So, the opposite side of "H" will be side "D".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
